id_routing.description: Interconnect may append bits to AxID to identify the originating master; slave-side ID_WIDTH > master-side ID_WIDTH
id_routing.compliance_note: Returning ID is the WIDER value; routing strips appended bits before returning to the master

fields.topology_type: Single-client / multi-server request/reply application protocol; the underlying transport (RTU/ASCII on EIA/TIA-485 multi-drop, RTU/ASCII on EIA/TIA-232 point-to-point, or Modbus TCP on switched Ethernet) determines the physical interconnect.

supported_topologies.name: RS-485 multi-drop (Modbus RTU / ASCII)
supported_topologies.description: 1 master + up to 247 individual servers (addresses 1..247) on a half-duplex differential pair. Broadcast (address 0) reaches all.

supported_topologies.name: RS-232 point-to-point (Modbus RTU / ASCII)
supported_topologies.description: 1 client + 1 server on a 2-wire async serial link.

supported_topologies.name: Switched Ethernet (Modbus TCP)
supported_topologies.description: Each MODBUS endpoint behind a TCP socket on its MAC + IP. Server reserves TCP port 502.

supported_topologies.name: Modbus gateway (TCP ↔ RTU bridge)
supported_topologies.description: Terminates TCP, originates RTU on downstream serial sub-networks. MBAP.Unit_ID routes to specific serial addresses.

master_slave_role_summary.description: Sole initiator. Builds request PDU, sends it, awaits response.
Responds to addressed requests; never initiates.
Bridges TCP front-end to downstream serial sub-network.

fields.interconnect_role: MODBUS itself defines no routing or switching — every transaction is unicast addressed by RTU address (serial) or MBAP Unit ID + IP/port (TCP). Routing across transports is handled by Modbus gateways.

ordering_guarantees.within_a_message: Bytes appear on wire in transport-specific order: Address → PDU → CRC (RTU); ':' → ADDR → FC → DATA → LRC → CR LF (ASCII); MBAP → PDU (TCP).
ordering_guarantees.across_messages: Serial: one transaction in flight at a time. TCP: multiple transactions per socket, disambiguated by Transaction ID; responses may arrive in any order.

fields.memory_vs_peripheral_regions: MODBUS exposes 4 logical data tables each addressed 0..65535 in the PDU. Physical mapping is vendor-specific.

slave_classification.event_target: MODBUS does not natively support unsolicited server-to-client notifications.
slave_classification.gateway_target: Server addressed indirectly via gateway by setting MBAP.Unit_ID.

broadcast_topology_rtu_ascii.valid_function_codes: Writes that can be applied unconditionally — typical: FC 0x05, 0x06, 0x0F, 0x10, 0x16.
broadcast_topology_rtu_ascii.invalid_for_broadcast: All Read codes (no useful response possible).
broadcast_topology_rtu_ascii.server_action: Process the request; do NOT transmit any response.

gateway_routing_topology.tcp_front_end: Listens on TCP port 502; demultiplexes by source IP / TCP-connection.
gateway_routing_topology.failure_modes: Exception 0x0A GATEWAY PATH UNAVAILABLE; 0x0B GATEWAY TARGET DEVICE FAILED TO RESPOND.
